class.name: OcgTDFChildiditerator
class.brief_description: Iterates on the children of a label, to find attributes having ID as Attribute ID.
class.description: ! Iterates on the children of a label, to find ! attributes having ID as Attribute ID. ! ! Level option works as TDF_ChildIterator.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Iterates on the children of the given label. If <allLevels> option is set to true, it explores not only the first, but all the sub label levels.

method.name: Initialize
method.description: Initializes the iteration on the children of the given label. If <allLevels> option is set to true, it explores not only the first, but all the sub label levels.

method.name: More
method.description: Returns True if there is a current Item in the iteration.

method.name: NextBrother
method.description: Move to the next Brother. If there is none, go up etc. This method is interesting only with "allLevels" behavior, because it avoids to explore the current label children.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the current item; a null handle if there is none.
